description: live-provider.ts runStt re-decodes the entire open utterance every INTERIM_EVERY_SAMPLES (1.2 s) and again when it ends; utterances can reach maxSpeechMs 15 s. Change to: (1) LocalAgreement-2 style commit (text agreeing across two consecutive decodes is committed and emitted final); (2) decode only the uncommitted tail plus small overlap; (3) cut segments at VAD probability dips about every 6-8 s rather than a hard 15 s cut; (4) if no new audio since the last interim, promote it to the final instead of decoding again; (5) consider lowering live minSilenceMs (final pass corrects errors). Keep token timing segment-interpolated semantics and replaceProvisional behaviour. Unit tests + live harness latency assertion from A0. Largely superseded for Moonshine Streaming by B3 but still applies to the Whisper live path (auto language).
title: Stop re-decoding whole utterances in live STT
